items.title: AI governance and prompt operations
items.description: We helped Ellavox develop Elacity Control Plane, a platform for managing prompts and AI agents. Our work covered approval workflows, monitoring, notifications, provider integrations and subscription billing.

items.title: AI-powered drug repurposing research
items.description: We helped build Orchard, a research platform for Every Cure. Researchers can search drug–disease data, apply detailed filters, share their findings and coordinate reviews as they explore new uses for existing medicines.

items.title: AI-powered clinical trial research
items.description: We helped build an AI-powered research workspace for Confyde. It brings clinical trial search, study comparison and interactive data views together, helping researchers explore evidence and investigate clinical development questions.
